SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty), 0) q FROM order_lines l JOIN orders o ON o.id = l.order_id
    WHERE l.offer_line_id = ? AND o.status <> 'anulata' AND o.id <> ?
SELECT o.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offer_lines l WHERE l.offer_id = o.id) n FROM offers o WHERE o.company_id = ? ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT o.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM opening_items i WHERE i.opening_id = o.id) n, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(kg), 0) FROM opening_items i WHERE i.opening_id = o.id) kg
     FROM openings o WHERE o.point_id = ? ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT i.hu_id, h.code hu, a.sku, a.name article, c.name category, e.code ewc, i.lot, i.kg, ? date, ? point, 'Stoc inițial' origin, i.created_by operator
    FROM opening_items i JOIN hus h ON h.id = i.hu_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = i.article_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = i.ewc_id
    WHERE i.opening_id = ? ORDER BY i.id

SELECT o.id, o.number, o.type, p.name partner, d.name dest FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = o.partner_id LEFT JOIN points d ON d.id = o.dest_point_id
    WHERE o.point_id = ? AND o.type IN ('vanzare','transfer') AND o.status IN ('ciorna','in_aprobare','aprobata','in_expeditie') ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT s.*, h.code hu, a.name article, a.sku, a.type, COALESCE(rc.name, a.type) typeName, COALESCE(c.name, 'Fără categorie') category,
  e.code ewc, g.code org, pt.name point, p.name partner, o.number order_no, op.number opening_no, ro.number res_order_no
  FROM stock s JOIN articles a ON a.id = s.article_id LEFT JOIN hus h ON h.id = s.hu_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id
  LEFT JOIN categories rc ON rc.parent_id IS NULL AND rc.root = a.type LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = s.ewc_id LEFT JOIN orgs g ON g.id = s.org_id
  LEFT JOIN points pt ON pt.id = s.point_id LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = s.partner_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = s.order_id
  LEFT JOIN openings op ON op.id = s.opening_id LEFT JOIN orders ro ON ro.id = s.res_order_id

SELECT s.hu_id, h.code hu, a.sku, a.name article, c.name category, e.code ewc, s.lot, s.kg, s.stock_date date, pt.name point,
    CASE WHEN s.source = 'stoc_initial' THEN 'Stoc inițial' ELSE COALESCE(p.name, '') END origin,
    COALESCE((SELECT created_by FROM reception_items WHERE id = s.item_id), (SELECT created_by FROM openings WHERE id = s.opening_id), '') operator
    FROM stock s JOIN hus h ON h.id = s.hu_id JOIN articles a ON a.id = s.article_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = a.category_id LEFT JOIN ewc e ON e.id = s.ewc_id
    LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = s.partner_id LEFT JOIN points pt ON pt.id = s.point_id
    WHERE s.hu_id IN ({0}) AND s.status IN ({1}) ORDER BY s.id
